title: "Architecture"

<!-- GENERATED by website/scripts/sync-docs.mjs from docs/architecture.md. Edit the source. -->

Kavach is Zyvor’s unified endpoint security controller: host process and file observation, optional eBPF telemetry, Netra network-event correlation, AI assist, and an investigation API/console. It is **observation-first** — no automatic containment.

Sister product: **Netra** (network XDR / eBPF datapath). Kavach owns host EDR; Netra owns network datapath. Together they form Zyvor XDR.

---

## Hard rule

```text
DETECT + REPORT  ✓
CONTAIN / KILL / ISOLATE / DROP  ✗
```

- Prevention policies and IOA/IOC drive `Detect()` only.  
- Containment APIs append a **request ledger**.  
- eBPF programs never return deny / drop.  
- AI recommends; it does not act.

## Component diagram

```text
  Browser / curl / kavachctl / MCP / SIEM
                    │
                    ▼
         ┌──────────────────────┐
         │   kavach (server)    │
         │   :8099 / :30899     │
         │                      │
         │  • HTTP /v1 API      │
         │  • dashboard.html    │
         │  • findings store    │
         │  • incident ledger   │
         │  • AI platform       │
         │  • eBPF platform API │
         │  • world inventory   │
         │  • SIEM exporter     │
         └──────────┬───────────┘
                    │
         bearer token / session cookie / optional mTLS
                    │
      ┌─────────────┴──────────────┐
      ▼                            ▼
 ┌─────────────┐            ┌──────────────────┐
 │ kavach agent│            │ netra-bridge /   │
 │             │            │ Netra poller     │
 │ /proc poll  │            │ network events   │
 │ proc conn.  │            │ drops / flows    │
 │ eBPF pins   │            │ (never write     │
 │ collectors  │            │  Netra BPF maps) │
 └─────────────┘            └──────────────────┘
```

## Binaries

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `cmd/kavach` | Controller (`-mode server`) or agent (`-mode agent`) |
| `cmd/kavachctl` | Operator CLI (sister to `netractl`) |
| `cmd/kavach-mcp` | MCP stdio server for AI agents |
| `cmd/netra-bridge` | Stdin JSONL → `POST /v1/network-events` |

---

## Packages

| Package | Responsibility |
|---------|----------------|
| `internal/edr` | Store, Detect(), APIs, console, world/AI/eBPF/finance platforms |
| `internal/mcpserver` | Minimal MCP framing for `kavach-mcp` |
| `bpf/` | CO-RE observation objects (exec, process, file, priv, net) |
| `helm/kavach` | Deployment, agent DaemonSet, Envoy Gateway opts |

---

## Data path

1. **Discover** — agent uses eBPF pin (if present) → proc connector → `/proc` poll.  
2. **Detect** — process/file/network signals evaluated by rules, IOC/IOA, custom STAR-style rules.  
3. **Persist** — findings and recent events in bounded JSONL; inventory domains in `*.inventory.json`.  
4. **Correlate** — Netra-shaped network events join by host + PID; threat graph / storyline APIs.  
5. **Present** — console, `kavachctl`, MCP tools, SIEM webhook/syslog/NDJSON.  
6. **Assist** — AI Hub scores, briefs, NL hunt (optional external LLM).

Bootstrap on empty stores seeds live inventory so demos are never blank (`BootstrapLivePlatform`).

---

## Trust & network boundaries

| Surface | Default |
|---------|---------|
| Local listen | Loopback HTTP `:8099` |
| Helm chart | In-pod HTTPS, NodePort **30899** |
| Envoy Gateway | Optional HTTPS NodePort **30943** (`kavach.<ip>.sslip.io`) |
| Auth | `KAVACH_TOKEN` bearer; console session cookie via `POST /v1/session` |
| Agent auth | Same bearer; optional mTLS (`docs/agent-mtls.md`) |
| TLS verify | Lab often uses self-signed → `KAVACH_TLS_INSECURE=true` |

---

## eBPF placement

```text
  Host kernel                     Userspace
  ───────────                     ─────────
  kavach_*.o ──ringbuf──► pin ──► WatchEBPF / ingest
                                  │
                                  ▼
                           /v1/ebpf/events
                           Detect() / console
```

Netra’s TCX/XDP/cgroup programs are **out of process**. Kavach polls Netra observe APIs and exposes `/v1/ebpf/netra/*` mirrors. See [ebpf.md](ebpf.md).

## API map (high level)

| Prefix | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `/healthz` | Liveness |
| `/v1/summary`, `/v1/findings`, `/v1/detections` | Core EDR |
| `/v1/fleet`, `/v1/hosts`, `/v1/agents` | Fleet |
| `/v1/hunt/*`, `/v1/timeline`, `/v1/threat-graph` | Hunt |
| `/v1/ai/*` | AI Hub |
| `/v1/ebpf/*` | eBPF observe platform |
| `/v1/finance/*` | Banks / markets / payments (observe — never freezes money) |
| `/v1/sectors/*` | Railways / govt / energy / aviation / … (observe — never stops services) |
| `/v1/world/*` + inventory domains | Global catalog |
| `/v1/siem/*` | Export |
| `/v1/session` | Console login |

Contract: [openapi.yaml](https://github.com/zyvorai/zyvor-kavach/blob/main/docs/openapi.yaml).

## Kubernetes layout

```text
kavach-system
  ├─ Deployment/kavach          controller
  ├─ DaemonSet/kavach-agent     optional node agents
  ├─ Service NodePort 30899
  └─ (optional) Envoy Gateway + HTTPRoute :30943
```

Chart: `helm/kavach`. Deploy script: `scripts/deploy-remote.sh`.
